supportingSourceReferences.description: Restricts AUTHORIZED_HOSTS to YouTube; rejects all other domains as UNSUPPORTED_URL.
detectUrlSource() identifies 'tiktok' purely based on string matching hostname.endsWith('tiktok.com').
Authenticated entry point enforcing same-origin, CSRF token, and readAssetImportRequest().
Validates JSON body and asserts classified.kind === 'SUPPORTED_YOUTUBE', rejecting non-YouTube inputs with 422.
Executes packaged yt-dlp, inspects MP4 via FFmpeg, streams to GCS, and commits PostgreSQL job/media records.
Registers jobs and media records in workflow.jobs and workflow.media.
Enforces check constraint ck_asset_import_authority: command_version = '1.0' AND platform = 'youtube'.
Defines Source Artifact identity semantics; states V1 source types are upload and youtube.
Outlines SourceAdapter boundary, mentions future TikTokSourceAdapter, and strictly forbids bypasses and scraping.
Defines TikTok clipping target profile with 15-55s duration policy and 0.22 hook weighting.
Renders 9:16 vertical MP4s via FFmpeg scale/crop and packages into ZIP via AdmZip.
UI component showing Universal URL Import text box, YouTube import handler, and video upload dropzone.
